title: AI Meeting Bot Invite
scenario: A bot joins a confidential meeting and asks for calendar permissions.

answers.A: Act immediately because the request sounds urgent and important.
answers.B: Use the approved company system or verified process.
answers.C: Escalate to IT, finance, HR, legal, or your manager through official channels.
answers.D: Reply to the sender asking them to confirm the request.

explanation: AI Meeting Bot Invite: the trap is to get access to an account, code, password, or permission. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Meeting bots need approval before access to sensitive meetings.
